data.name: GCR4 Geoff Crammond
data.detailed_description:
Geoff Crammond Racing 4 

Geoff Crammond Racing 4 is the definitive return of the legendary racing simulation experience. Originally released in the early 2000s and now officially reintroduced by MicroProse and Geoff Crammond, GCR4 brings back the acclaimed driving engine, deep physics model, and immersive race weekend structure that set the standard for sim racing.

Step into the cockpit of high-performance, open-wheel racing machines and compete across a full season of intense races on world-class circuits, each inspired by iconic tracks, but reimagined with new names and visuals. Every corner, elevation change, and pit strategy matters.

Key Features:

  • Authentic Driving Physics – Realistic car handling, dynamic weather, and advanced tyre and fuel simulation.

  • Race Weekend Experience – Practice, qualifying, warm-up, and full race sessions.

  • Dynamic AI – Intelligent, aggressive opponents that adapt and make mistakes.

  • Comprehensive Setup Options – Fine-tune every aspect of your car’s performance to suit your driving style and the track.

  • Full Season Mode – Compete for the championship across a variety of challenging circuits.

  • Steam Workshop Support – Customize your game with new teams, drivers, liveries, and track names. Rename any track, team or driver in the game to suit your vision.

  • Replays & Data Analysis – Study your performance with full race replays and telemetry.

  • Dynamic Weather Conditions: Face-changing weather that affects track conditions and race strategies.

  • Customizable Settings: Adjust car setups and driving aids to suit your racing style.

GCR4 retains the technical excellence and racing purity that defined the genre, with modding and customization front and centre.

Geoff Crammond Racing 4 is the ultimate racing simulation that brings the thrill of high-speed racing to your fingertips. Experience the adrenaline rush of competing in the world's most prestigious motorsport series, featuring customizable teams, drivers, and circuits. With its advanced physics engine, realistic car handling, and dynamic weather conditions, Geoff Crammond Racing 4 offers an unparalleled nostalgic racing experience.

Dive into various game modes, including a comprehensive career mode where you can manage your team, develop your car, and compete for the championship title. The game features stunning graphics and detailed car models, immersing you in the world of racing like never before. Whether you're a seasoned racer or a newcomer to the genre, Geoff Crammond Racing 4 provides a challenging and rewarding experience.

Customize your racing experience with various options, from adjusting car setups to fine-tuning your driving style. Compete against AI opponents that mimic real-world racing strategies or challenge your friends in multiplayer mode. Its rich history and legacy, Geoff Crammond Racing 4 remains a beloved classic among racing enthusiasts.

The legacy continues. Welcome to Geoff Crammond Racing 4.

  • Storage: 1 GB available space
